scientific_integrity: Finite bipartite monomer covariance signs and the qualitative Laguerre-to-Bessel limit are classical consequences. The quantitative statements concern the order and first-order error of the Bessel approximation in this matching model and explicit covariance coefficients. Finite tests supplement the proofs; no exhaustive priority or formal verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform positive edge activity on complete bipartite graphs with n≥2. The scaling and error statements keep the imbalance and c fixed; no growing-imbalance or heterogeneous-activity limit is asserted.
title: A Bessel saturation window and signed monomer correlations on complete bipartite graphs
